name: common
description: An opt-in browser canvas interface for collaborative walkthroughs, annotations, approved host-page context, generated image imports, snapshots, and local video recording.
url_resolution: Resolve relative URLs against this manifest's URL

browser_js.window_scope: Common's iframe when embedded; Common's top-level window when standalone

web_mcp.arguments: Tool inputSchema arguments without the action field
web_mcp.availability: Only tools allowed by the current grant are registered; source tools also require an attached page companion

access.scope: Current browser tab and its admitted canvas session
access.editing: Disabled by default; select timed capabilities in the visible Agent tools controls
access.revocation: Expiry, user revocation, disconnection, reload, or canvas session change ends access
access.screen_capture: Requires the user's native browser share picker approval
access.image_generation: External agent capability; import generated raster output
access.recordings: Video-only local browser blobs; download before reload
access.page_context: Separate default-off grant for an attached same-origin host companion; sharing video does not grant page inspection

manifest_type: Common-specific browser interface discovery; not an A2A Agent Card

content_discovery.scope: Current admitted canvas; active board only in Space & Time

search.matches: Literal case-insensitive words across title, text, and diagram source

read.content: Exact pages of one object text, title, or diagram source

content_discovery.pagination: Repeat the same request with returned nextOffset; null means the end. Pages reflect live content, not a frozen snapshot.
content_discovery.privacy: Public discovery files describe interfaces; canvas content requires admission and a current human inspection grant

page_context.scope: Approved description and named visible targets from the same-origin host page attached to this Common mount
page_context.binding: Only a matching live browser-tab capture handle, origin, and local screen object establish a verified video binding
page_context.highlight: Temporary local overlay; requires canvas-write, current target revision, and verified binding; no shared/exported object or history entry. Source-video pixels can include visible Common UI.
page_context.privacy: No automatic DOM/form-value collection, page clicks, independent-window access, or replication of context to other participants
